Nina (People Ops): Thanks for joining the post-all-hands Q&A channel thread! Dropping clarifications on hybrid/offsite/travel ops from today's session.
Ethan (CTO): Appreciate this. Two quick asks: 1) who owns approval for cross-region travel, and 2) how to request hardware shipping when teammates attend offsites?
Nina (People Ops): Cross-region travel (e.g., NA -> EU) needs manager + finance partner sign-off. For hardware shipping, fill the Equipment Travel Request form and tag eng-ops; include serials.
Rae (Eng): For small team retreats (<10 ppl) can we use team credit card instead of individual reimbursements? Less fiddly.
Harper (Finance): Team card ok for under $2k events if cardholder is pre-authorized. For recurring or >$2k, we need a PO and vendor invoice.
Diego (Growth): Any guidelines on swag budget for offsites? We want to give small gifts.
Nina (People Ops): Swag is allowed if under $15/person without prior approval. For branded electronics or >$15, route to procurement.
TravelBot: FYI: new travel partner policy updated. Preferred carriers list: ExampleAir, SkyConnect. Travel vendor contact: travel@redwood.
Rae (Eng): What's the expectation around work vs social time at retreats? Need to set expectations for schedules.
Nina (People Ops): Aim for 60/40 split work/social for full-day retreats. Include a working agenda and one social block. Put "Focus hours" in calendar invites.
Ethan (CTO): Security note: if bringing external guests or consultants, make sure you submit visitor form at least 7 business days prior. Any >14 days requires security review.
Harper (Finance): Reimbursement tip: consolidate receipts into one PDF where possible. For shared rooms, whoever pays submits full receipt and others add a note listing names and amounts.
Diego (Growth): Can we expense coworking passes while traveling between hubs? e.g., day passes in a city.
Nina (People Ops): Yes, coworking is allowed up to $30/day. Use expense category "Coworking" and attach booking confirmation.
Rae (Eng): Are we still prioritizing small local meetups over big all-company events?
Ethan (CTO): Yes — leadership prefers more frequent local gatherings. Larger company events will be less frequent but still happen annually.
Nina (People Ops): I'll publish a one-page checklist (travel approvals, expense flow, vendor checklist) by Friday and pin it here. Link will be: https://intra.redwood/workstyle/mini-checklist
Diego (Growth): Thanks! One last Q 2: Airbnb vs hotel? What's preferred for multi-night team stays?
Harper (Finance): Hotels preferred for corporate rates and itemized invoices. AirBnB allowed for smaller groups if you can provide itemized invoices and host name.
Nina (People Ops): If you have follow-ups, drop them below or DM me. We'll update the public FAQ after we collate any edge cases. :thumbsup:
